We can offer the following slots (PT):
- Tue, Dec 14 — 09:30 or 10:30
- Wed, Dec 15 — 10:00 (preferred by our team)
- Thu, Dec 16 — 08:30 or 11:00

Alex or Marcus can run the live demo; Monica (CC'd) will cover post-demo onboarding and procurement handoffs. Vanessa is looped for any product deep-dive / engineering availability.

1) Can you confirm which Opsly stakeholders need to attend (procurement vs engineering vs exec)?
2) Are there any specific scale/cost questions you want us to focus on (reserved capacity pricing, latency targets, data residency)?

I can send a calendar invite as soon as you confirm a slot. HubSpot link and the latest deck are here: https://hubspot.example/deal/OPS-2026-0472 and https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/opsly/demo-deck-v3
